name: Restless Spirits

start.dialog: There are spirits here... trapped by the Foundation disruptions. They need to be sent to the Farplane. But I need protection while I perform the ritual. Will you guard me?
start.objective: Protect Yuna while she performs the Sending ritual for restless spirits

progress.dialog: The spirits are agitated! They don't want to go! Please, hold them back just a little longer!
progress.objective: Defend against waves of angry spirits

complete.dialog: It's done. They are at peace now. Thank you for protecting me. Take this - a summoner gem. It holds the essence of Valefor. Use it to call the winds!

party_comments.kade: Giving peace to the dead... that's important work.
party_comments.vex: The Sending... I have heard of this ritual. Sacred duty.
party_comments.nix7: Spirit energy levels decreasing. Ritual: successful.

hidden_outcome: If no spirits touch Yuna during the ritual, she gives you 'Nirvana' - her ultimate staff
